headline: Clinton order adjusts certain federal pay rates, likely as part of the yearly federal pay update.
what_it_does: This executive order changes certain rates of pay set by the federal government. Only the title was provided, so the exact pay scales and amounts are not listed here. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to set new pay rates for federal civilian workers and members of the military.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may change under the adjusted pay schedules.
Their pay may be included in the adjustments, as is common in yearly pay orders, though the source does not confirm this.
